label: Дверь
description: Case ladder, plurals, and prepositional scenes for the feminine 3rd-declension noun дверь.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 1. 'Дверь' is the grammatical subject in the nominative case. 2. The short adjective 'открыта' agrees as feminine singular. 3. A clean baseline for the lemma.

Strategic focus: Accusative object. 1. 'Дверь' is the direct object; for this 3rd-decl noun nom and acc are identical. 2. 'Открыл' is a high-frequency action verb. 3. The most common collocation with this word.

missions.phrase: Он быстро закрыл за собой дверь.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Accusative object. 1. 'Дверь' takes the accusative, unchanged from the nominative form. 2. 'Закрыл' pairs with it as a core household verb. 3. The mirror action to opening.
Strategic focus: Genitive of belonging. 1. 'Двери' is genitive after 'от', marking source. 2. In 3rd declension gen, dat and prep all collapse to 'двери'. 3. Notice the syncretic ending.
Strategic focus: Genitive of possession. 1. 'Двери' is genitive, showing whose handle it is. 2. The bare possessive needs no preposition. 3. Same form as dative and prepositional here.
Strategic focus: Dative of direction. 1. 'Двери' is dative after 'к', marking the goal of motion. 2. Identical in form to the genitive 'двери'. 3. The preposition signals which case is meant.

missions.phrase: Кто-то начал громко стучать в дверь.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Accusative with motion. 1. 'Дверь' is accusative after 'в', here the surface struck. 2. 'Стучать' governs 'в' plus accusative. 3. A fixed everyday collocation.
Strategic focus: Instrumental of location. 1. 'Дверью' is instrumental after 'за', meaning behind. 2. The distinctive '-ью' ending marks the instrumental. 3. A vivid spatial scene.
Strategic focus: Instrumental of position. 1. 'Дверью' stays instrumental after 'перед', meaning in front of. 2. The '-ью' form is unique to this case. 3. Pairs naturally with 'за дверью'.

Strategic focus: Prepositional of location. 1. 'Двери' is prepositional after 'на', marking surface. 2. Same form as genitive and dative in this declension. 3. The static 'на' triggers the prepositional.
Strategic focus: Prepositional surface. 1. 'Двери' is prepositional after 'на', locating the note. 2. The ending matches gen, dat and prep across 3rd declension. 3. A small realistic phrase.
Strategic focus: Adjective agreement, nominative. 1. 'Входная' agrees with 'дверь' as feminine singular. 2. 'Дверь' is the nominative subject. 3. A common compound naming the front entrance.

Strategic focus: Adjective agreement, nominative. 1. 'Открытая' is a feminine singular adjective matching 'дверь'. 2. The phrase stands as a noun group in the nominative. 3. Reinforces feminine endings.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 1. 'Двери' is nominative plural, the subject. 2. The short adjective 'закрыты' agrees as plural. 3. Singular gen and plural nom look alike but differ in number.
Strategic focus: Accusative plural. 1. 'Двери' is accusative plural, the direct object. 2. For this inanimate noun nom and acc plural coincide. 3. 'Покрасили' is a concrete household verb.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural. 1. 'Дверей' is genitive plural after the quantifier 'много'. 2. The '-ей' ending marks the plural genitive. 3. Quantity words demand this case.
Strategic focus: Genitive of proximity. 1. 'Двери' is genitive after 'у', meaning by or near. 2. The ending repeats the gen-dat-prep syncretism. 3. A frequent way to say standing at a door.
